verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents a pricing page stating that registrations and auto-renewals are charged at member-level rates with no membership or API fee. Separate quote endpoints mint prices for register, renew, and transfer, so per-operation pricing is discoverable programmatically. However, nothing shows a published full per-TLD price list, and nothing shows that first-year and renewal prices match. missing for 10: a published per-TLD price table, registration/renewal/transfer prices shown side by side, evidence of no teaser-to-renewal spike, independent corroboration.
